document.title: Hengshi Design Phase 1 Evidence and Claims Ledger

rules: An approved offer or target audience is not evidence of past delivery, customer outcomes, geographic presence, certification, or market leadership.
Prototype seeds and historical snapshots remain quarantined unless independent evidence review and founder publication approval change their disposition.
A capability demonstration must be Hengshi-owned, reproducible, clearly labeled as a demo, and separated from verified client work.
A verified client case requires authorized source evidence, claim-by-claim review, publication consent, and founder approval.
Named experts, biographies, portraits, credentials, legal details, contact facts, and sameAs profiles cannot be inferred.
Defense content remains unpublished and unindexed until the specific founder, legal, security, claim, data, and AI gates pass.

entries.subject: Public display name: Hengshi Design
entries.allowedUse: Use the exact display name consistently to identify the intended brand entity.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not imply a verified legal entity name, registration, office, or jurisdiction.
entries.requiredEvidence: Verified legal entity and disclosure facts under MA-002.
entries.approvalGate: Phase 1 scope and claims approval; Phase 4 publication approval

entries.subject: Premium, platform-oriented innovation delivery positioning for global mid-market and enterprise buyers
entries.allowedUse: Describe the intended offer, audience, and strategy-to-delivery engagement model.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not convert positioning into claims of global operations, enterprise customer history, leadership, superiority, or measured outcomes.
entries.requiredEvidence: Founder-approved messaging and evidence review of every substantive capability statement.

entries.subject: Agriculture-first and mining-second sector priority
entries.allowedUse: Create agriculture and mining service-intersection content after expert evidence review.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not imply existing sector customers, deployments, outcomes, datasets, or domain credentials.
entries.requiredEvidence: Named subject-matter reviewer, claim sources, and founder publication approval for each sector page.

entries.subject: Five wings and ten formal service titles
entries.allowedUse: Use the approved taxonomy to define service navigation and offer pages.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not treat the taxonomy alone as proof that every capability has been delivered to a client.
entries.requiredEvidence: Specialist-reviewed service definitions, boundaries, delivery model, and approved proof or demo links.

entries.subject: Canonical host https://hengshidesign.com
entries.allowedUse: Use as the approved design-time canonical-host target in specifications.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not claim verified domain control or change DNS.
entries.requiredEvidence: Read-only ownership evidence followed by separately approved DNS and canonical-host verification.

entries.subject: World-first, best, leading, unique, or equivalent superiority claims
entries.allowedUse: World-first may remain an internal creative ambition only.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: No novelty, market-leadership, best-in-class, award, rating, or superiority claim.
entries.requiredEvidence: Independent substantiation and legal clearance for the exact wording and comparison set.
entries.approvalGate: Founder plus independent legal and evidence review

entries.subject: Atlas Immersive Launch project seed
entries.allowedUse: Local prototype and test data only.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not present as client work, a case study, a testimonial, or an outcome.
entries.requiredEvidence: Client identity/authorization or proof that a rebuilt version is a Hengshi-owned demo, plus source assets and claim evidence.

entries.subject: Vertex SaaS Platform project seed
entries.allowedUse: Local prototype and test data only.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not claim a global B2B logistics client, multi-tenant scale, delivery, or outcome.
entries.requiredEvidence: Authorized client evidence or a separately built and labeled Hengshi-owned demo with reproducible proof.

entries.subject: Signal AI Command Center project seed
entries.allowedUse: Local prototype and test data only.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not claim deployed agentic compliance, audit, or anomaly-detection capability or outcomes.
entries.requiredEvidence: Approved demo specification and evidence or authorized client proof, including AI/security review.
entries.approvalGate: MA-003, AI/security review, and founder publication approval

entries.subject: Drift Commerce Suite project seed
entries.allowedUse: Local prototype and test data only.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not claim a delivered commerce platform, payments, subscriptions, performance, or analytics outcome.
entries.requiredEvidence: Authorized client evidence or a separately built, labeled, and reviewed Hengshi-owned demo.

entries.subject: Lumen Data Foundation project seed
entries.allowedUse: Local prototype and test data only.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not claim an enterprise lakehouse, lineage, streaming, dashboard, or executive outcome.
entries.requiredEvidence: Authorized client evidence or a separately built, labeled, and reviewed Hengshi-owned demo.

entries.subject: Aegis Security Overhaul project seed
entries.allowedUse: Local prototype and test data only.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not claim a global fintech client, zero-trust delivery, compliance automation, incident response, or audit result.
entries.requiredEvidence: Authorized client evidence or a separately built and labeled demo plus independent security/claim review.
entries.approvalGate: MA-003, independent security review, and founder publication approval

entries.subject: Project media URLs under assets.example.com
entries.allowedUse: Schema and local fixture evidence only.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not render, index, cite, or represent the URLs as owned case-study media.
entries.requiredEvidence: Licensed project-owned or client-authorized media, provenance, alt text, consent, and security review.

entries.subject: Nine seeded service descriptions and deliverables
entries.allowedUse: Inventory input for specialist-authored service definitions under the approved taxonomy.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not publish current first-person delivery claims or deliverables without feasibility, ownership, and evidence review.
entries.requiredEvidence: Service owner review, delivery boundary, acceptance model, proof or demo linkage, and founder approval.

entries.subject: Creative & Visual Design Services offer
entries.allowedUse: Reserve the approved service route and define a specialist-reviewed offer.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not publish tool-specific capability, production, portfolio, or outcome claims from the legacy consolidation.
entries.requiredEvidence: Approved scope, named service owner, delivery model, licensed proof/demo, and founder approval.

entries.subject: Legal entity, controller, jurisdiction, business address, privacy contact, and public disclosures
entries.allowedUse: Record as a launch dependency only.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not invent or infer legal names, registrations, addresses, jurisdictions, or controller details.
entries.requiredEvidence: Founder-supplied non-secret facts and dated independent legal review.

entries.subject: Historical statement that Zaryab owns Hengshi Design and is a solo consultant
entries.allowedUse: Founder interview prompt only.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not publish ownership, founder biography, employment, legal status, or expert credentials from this note.
entries.requiredEvidence: Founder-approved biography, role, qualifications, consent, legal entity relationship, and portrait/media rights.
entries.approvalGate: MA-002, MA-003, and expert/person publication approval

entries.subject: Named experts, biographies, credentials, portraits, and publication consent
entries.allowedUse: Reserve expert route patterns and define the evidence workflow.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not create a person profile, byline, portrait, credential, quote, or structured Person graph.
entries.requiredEvidence: Identity, role, qualifications, biography, portrait rights, consent, and claim-review responsibility.
entries.approvalGate: MA-003 and per-person founder publication approval

entries.subject: Client identities, logos, testimonials, awards, ratings, quantified outcomes, and partner badges
entries.allowedUse: Maintain an empty verified-work state and invite founder evidence through the approved process.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: No logo wall, review aggregate, testimonial, award, partner badge, result, or customer count.
entries.requiredEvidence: Source record, authorization, claim substantiation, media rights, reviewer approval, and founder approval.

entries.subject: Atlanta or Hengshi HQ geographic presence
entries.allowedUse: Internal asset identification and prototype comparison only.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not claim an Atlanta headquarters, office, address, local service area, or create a geographic landing page.
entries.requiredEvidence: Verified legal/business location and founder-approved disclosure.

entries.subject: February 2026 percentage readiness scorecard and capacity estimates
entries.allowedUse: Historical reconciliation input only.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not present 40%, 90%, 60%, capacity, throughput, timing, or similar estimates as current evidence.
entries.requiredEvidence: Current deterministic acceptance evidence for the exact readiness or performance statement.
entries.approvalGate: Relevant later-phase validation and founder release approval

entries.subject: Existing exterior GLB provenance, commercial rights, and editable source
entries.allowedUse: Protected visual comparison reference only.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: No geometry reuse, modification, relicensing, attribution statement, or production switch.
entries.requiredEvidence: Original source, author, license text, commercial modification rights, attribution, provenance, and security review.

entries.subject: Six launch cornerstone insights and continuing editorial cadence
entries.allowedUse: Define expert-reviewed briefs, evidence standards, and production workflow.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not prepublish empty, thin, mass-generated, anonymous, or unreviewed articles.
entries.requiredEvidence: Approved brief, named qualified reviewer, primary sources, original value, review date, and founder publication approval.

entries.subject: Organization sameAs profiles and public social accounts
entries.allowedUse: Omit sameAs until profiles are verified and approved.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not guess profile URLs or connect unrelated Hengshi entities.
entries.requiredEvidence: Founder-confirmed organization-controlled profile URLs and ownership verification.

entries.subject: Defense-facing services, content, demos, datasets, campaigns, and AI routes
entries.allowedUse: Internal risk and gate planning only.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: No indexable route, public claim, demo, dataset, campaign, ordinary AI answer, or sensitive data handling.
entries.requiredEvidence: Exact-scope founder approval plus independent legal, security, export/control, claim, data-flow, and AI review.

entries.subject: ScienceSoft, Lusion, Bruno Simon, and Active Theory references
entries.allowedUse: Analyze public experience patterns, content architecture, progressive 3D, and conversion hypotheses without copying.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not imply affiliation, endorsement, partnership, client relationship, copied design, or comparative superiority.
entries.requiredEvidence: Dated public-source observations and independent original design work.
entries.approvalGate: Phase 1 reference synthesis and later design approval

entries.subject: Global audience target versus global operating footprint
entries.allowedUse: State that the offer is intended for global English-speaking buyers.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not claim global offices, local teams, customers, delivery coverage, regulatory coverage, or 24/7 support.
entries.requiredEvidence: Verified operating, legal, staffing, support, and customer facts for any broader statement.

entries.subject: Public business, sales, booking, privacy, and security contact details
entries.allowedUse: Define required fields and route behavior without populating addresses or inboxes.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not publish example admin emails, test phone numbers, mailboxes, addresses, or recipients.
entries.requiredEvidence: Founder-approved public contacts, mailbox ownership, privacy/security routing, and consent.

entries.subject: Wing and room owners, reviewers, approvers, and backups
entries.allowedUse: Define role requirements and leave assignments explicitly pending.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not invent staff, availability, responsibility, expertise, or response times.
entries.requiredEvidence: Founder-approved owner, reviewer, approver, backup, biography, consent, and operating expectations.

entries.subject: Reception AI Concierge and specialist AI capabilities
entries.allowedUse: Describe the planned role, evidence-only answer boundary, refusal, source, and human-routing requirements in specifications.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not claim the AI is live, accurate, secure, resident, continuously available, or able to bind price, scope, timeline, legal terms, or delivery.
entries.requiredEvidence: Approved knowledge, provider entitlement, capability tests, citations/refusals, residency/security tests, and founder release approval.
entries.approvalGate: MA-005, MA-007, Phase 6 acceptance, and Phase 7 launch approval

entries.subject: Security, privacy, compliance, certification, uptime, RPO, and RTO statements
entries.allowedUse: State approved design requirements and publish truthful policy/control descriptions only after evidence review.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not claim certification, compliance, penetration-test status, current 99.9% SLA, achieved recovery, or guaranteed security.
entries.requiredEvidence: Implemented controls, independent review, operational evidence, legal clearance, and precise scope/date.
entries.approvalGate: Phase 1 security definition, later security/deployment review, and founder publication approval

entries.subject: Verified Work collection
entries.allowedUse: Define the collection, empty state, verification workflow, and canonical route pattern.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not place prototype seeds, unverified outcomes, or demos in Work.
entries.requiredEvidence: At least one authorized, claim-reviewed case or an approved decision for an honest empty collection state.
entries.approvalGate: MA-003 and per-case D-019 publication approval

entries.subject: Hengshi-owned Demos collection
entries.allowedUse: Define the collection, labeling, reproducibility, evidence, and canonical route pattern.
entries.prohibitedPublicUse: Do not relabel fictional client-style seeds as demos without rebuilding and documenting ownership and evidence.
entries.requiredEvidence: Hengshi ownership, asset provenance, reproducible demo, limitations, security review where applicable, and founder approval.
entries.approvalGate: MA-003 and per-demo D-019 publication approval
